Notice of modification (BigScience Open RAIL-M, paragraph 4(c))

The files duration_predictor.onnx, text_encoder.onnx, vector_estimator.onnx
and vocoder.onnx in this folder are modified derivatives of Supertone's
Supertonic 3 model (https://huggingface.co/Supertone/supertonic-3, revision
3cadd1ee6394adea1bd021217a0e650ede09a323).

They were changed as follows:
1. The k2-fsa sherpa-onnx project quantized Supertone's public ONNX graphs to
   INT8 (archive sherpa-onnx-supertonic-3-tts-int8-2026-05-11.tar.bz2).
2. Spoken Margins renamed the quantized graph files to match the official
   Supertonic Swift runtime and packaged them with the official configuration,
   Unicode index and preset voice styles, which are unchanged.

The model remains licensed under BigScience Open RAIL-M; see
../licenses/SUPERTONIC_MODEL_OPENRAIL-M.txt and ../licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

Spoken Margins on-device voice notices

Supertonic 3 model and preset voice styles
Copyright (c) 2026 Supertone Inc.
Licensed under BigScience Open RAIL-M. The complete license is included as
SUPERTONIC_MODEL_OPENRAIL-M.txt.

Supertonic Swift inference code
Copyright (c) 2026 Supertone Inc.
Adapted from https://github.com/supertone-inc/supertonic and licensed under
the MIT License included as SUPERTONIC_CODE_MIT.txt.

INT8 model conversion
The bundled ONNX graphs are modified, quantized derivatives of Supertonic 3.
They were produced by the k2-fsa sherpa-onnx project from Supertone's public
ONNX assets. Spoken Margins renamed the graph files for the official Swift
runtime contract and packaged them with the official configuration, Unicode
index, and preset voice-style files. The sherpa-onnx Apache 2.0 license is
included as SHERPA_ONNX_APACHE-2.0.txt.

ONNX Runtime
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
Licensed under the MIT License included as ONNXRUNTIME_MIT.txt. Notices for
its bundled third-party software are included in
ONNXRUNTIME_THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

No Supertone, sherpa-onnx, or Microsoft endorsement is implied.

Spoken Margins on-device voice notices: Kokoro-82M (Core ML)

Kokoro-82M model and voices
By hexgrad. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M). The complete license is
included as APACHE-2.0.txt.

Training data, as the Kokoro-82M model card credits it: Kokoro was trained
on permissive and non-copyrighted audio, including these CC BY datasets:
- Koniwa `tnc` (under 1 hour), CC BY 3.0,
  https://github.com/koniwa/koniwa
- SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database (under 11 hours), CC BY 4.0,
  https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/2353
Neither dataset is included in these files.

Core ML conversion
The files in coreml/, voices/ and runtime/ are the Core ML conversion of
Kokoro-82M published by Matt Mireles as mattmireles/kokoro-coreml
(https://huggingface.co/mattmireles/kokoro-coreml, revision
0c1d78b47d19f39be6bc0cf0d07316822ae879d4), licensed under the Apache
License 2.0. Spoken Margins downloads them unchanged; the compiled/ folder
is made on this device from them by Core ML.

Pronunciation dictionaries
The files in lexicon/ are misaki's American English dictionaries, us_gold.json and us_silver.json, by hexgrad
(https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki, commit e820629b96334db28227df37f280e4836d46fadb), licensed under the Apache
License 2.0 (the complete license is included as APACHE-2.0.txt). Spoken Margins downloads them unchanged and
makes a sorted copy on this device (lexicon/misaki-us.tsv) for looking words up. Kokoro was trained on text
phonemized with these dictionaries, so the app reads text with them first.

No endorsement by hexgrad, Matt Mireles or the dataset authors is implied.
